title: Closing a Debate and Summarising Outcomes
goal: Express results and extreme degrees with de tal manera que and hasta el punto de que, and read a televised debate transcript.
grammar: consecutive clauses with de tal manera que and hasta el punto de que

items: I can express a real or intended result with *de tal manera que* + indicative or subjunctive.
I can highlight an extreme degree with *hasta el punto de que* in debate summaries.
I can follow a televised round-table transcript and use terms for forums, summaries and closing arguments.
